title: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man

vibeProfile.oneLine: A young man breaks from church and country to become an artist.

summary: Stephen Dedalus grows from a small boy into a young man determined to become an artist, breaking free of family, nation and the Catholic Church that both shaped and stifled him. Joyce's semi-autobiographical novel is a landmark of modernism, its prose evolving from a child's fragments to soaring adolescent rhetoric as Stephen's mind matures. Intense, inward and beautifully written, it is the essential bridge between Dubliners and Ulysses, and a defining portrait of the artist finding his vocation.
whyReadIt: Joyce's beautiful portrait of an artist breaking free of church and country. The essential bridge to Ulysses.

funFacts.text: Its prose deliberately grows more complex as its hero grows up.
